title: Gaze Calibration Card
job_to_be_done: Help a person relying on eye input quickly decide whether their changing posture, wheelchair position, glasses, light, or fatigue has made gaze control unreliable before a frustrating interaction.
smallest_useful_product: A local 30-second nine-target check with directional error, dwell reliability, user-approved setup notes, local history, and support-friendly export.
constraints: Camera frames stay local; this implementation does not request camera access.
Measurements are device-dependent and not diagnostic.
Keyboard-only setup and high contrast are supported.
No cursor control, cloud analytics, or replacement for vendor calibration.
